```{r}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidyr)

### READ, KEEP DATA NEEDED FOR ALL THE PLOTS, for all user inputs #####

###### {r, read csv, format df}
YEAR <-  2025 #YEAR ENDING SPRING DATA, so CSV with same year as selected

###### read csv data
csv_file1 <- paste0("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Reading4All/NY/refs/heads/main/data/ELA/DATA_ELA-SPRING-", YEAR, ".csv")
csv_file2 <- paste0("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Reading4All/NY/refs/heads/main/data/ELA/DATA_ELA-SPRING-", YEAR-1, ".csv")
csv_file3 <- paste0("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Reading4All/NY/refs/heads/main/data/ELA/DATA_ELA-SPRING-", YEAR-2, ".csv")
csv_file4 <- paste0("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Reading4All/NY/refs/heads/main/data/ELA/DATA_ELA-SPRING-", YEAR-3, ".csv")
csv_file5 <- paste0("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Reading4All/NY/refs/heads/main/data/ELA/DATA_ELA-SPRING-", YEAR-4, ".csv")

df1 <- read.csv(csv_file1)
df2 <- read.csv(csv_file2)
df3 <- read.csv(csv_file3)
df4 <- read.csv(csv_file4)
df5 <- read.csv(csv_file5)

# combine
shared_data <- rbind(df1, df2, df3, df4, df5)

###### {r, Filter to keep all data we made need regardless of which year is selected}

## Only Keep Spring (year-end) Data
shared_data<-shared_data[(shared_data$SEASON == "Spring"),]

## Only Keep Subgroups to be used
shared_data<-shared_data[(shared_data$SUBGROUP_NAME == "Students with Disabilities" |
                          shared_data$SUBGROUP_NAME == "General Education Students" |
                          shared_data$SUBGROUP_NAME == "Economically Disadvantaged" |  
                          shared_data$SUBGROUP_NAME == "Not Economically Disadvantaged" |
                          shared_data$SUBGROUP_NAME == "All Students"
                          ),]

# Keep District and County Data
## (old) Only Keep District Data
## shared_data<-shared_data[(shared_data$ENTITY_TYPE == "DISTRICT"),]
shared_data <- shared_data[
  shared_data$ENTITY_TYPE == "DISTRICT" |
  shared_data$ENTITY_TYPE == "COUNTY",
]

# County row - formatting County descriptions, to work and look good on user input filters
## Populate count_desc of county rows with it's entity name (uppercase)
shared_data$COUNTY_DESC[shared_data$ENTITY_TYPE == "COUNTY"] <- 
  toupper(shared_data$ENTITY_NAME[shared_data$ENTITY_TYPE == "COUNTY"])
### then remove ' County'
shared_data$COUNTY_DESC[shared_data$ENTITY_TYPE == "COUNTY"] <- 
  sub(" COUNTY$", "", shared_data$COUNTY_DESC[shared_data$ENTITY_TYPE == "COUNTY"])

## Rename count_desc of 'NEW York' to New York (Manhattan) (uppercase) so it's less confusing
shared_data$COUNTY_DESC[shared_data$COUNTY_DESC == "NEW YORK"] <- "NEW YORK (MANHATTAN)"

## Rename County row entity_name's to 'ALL - COUNTY'
shared_data$ENTITY_NAME[shared_data$ENTITY_TYPE == "COUNTY"] <- 
  paste0("ALL - ", shared_data$ENTITY_NAME[shared_data$ENTITY_TYPE == "COUNTY"])
### then change ' County' text to " Districts'
shared_data$ENTITY_NAME[shared_data$ENTITY_TYPE == "COUNTY"] <- 
  sub(" County$", " Districts", shared_data$ENTITY_NAME[shared_data$ENTITY_TYPE == "COUNTY"])
### change 'ALL - New York Districts' text to " All - Manhattan Districts'
shared_data$ENTITY_NAME[shared_data$ENTITY_NAME == "ALL - New York Districts"] <- "ALL - Manhatten Districts"


# Get rid of NA Prof rates, and sort by Prof rate
shared_data <- shared_data %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Prof_Pct)) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(Prof_Pct, NotProf_Pct)
# Reindex the df, so the plot order will stay as we want:
if (nrow(shared_data) > 0){
rownames(shared_data) <- 1:nrow(shared_data)
}

#format
shared_data$ENTITY_CD <- format(shared_data$ENTITY_CD, scientific = FALSE)

## Create Proficiency count columns (based on ALL students, including those who opted out)
shared_data$Prof_Count <- with(shared_data, LEVEL3_COUNT + LEVEL4_COUNT)
shared_data$NotProf_Count <- with(shared_data, NUM_TESTED - Prof_Count)


#### make df available to OJS chunk
# df to ojs
ojs_define(df_to_js = shared_data) 

```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
```
```{ojs}
// guard function
// makes a submit and reset button to use after multiple inputs made, see https://observablehq.com/@mootari/inputs-submit

function guard(fn, options = {}) {
  const {
    submitLabel = "Submit",
    resetLabel = "Reset",
    required = false,
    resubmit = true,
    width = "fit-content", 
//    width = "min-content",
    justify = "start",
    valid = input => !input.querySelector(":invalid"),
  } = options;

  const onSubmit = () => {
    value = input.value;
    submit.disabled = !resubmit || invalid;
    reset.disabled = true;
    wrapper.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  };
  const onReset = () => {
    input.value = value;
    submit.disabled = !resubmit || invalid;
    reset.disabled = true;
  };
  const onInnerInputCapture = () => {
    invalid = true;
    submit.disabled = true;
  };
  const onInnerInput = e => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    submit.disabled = false;
    reset.disabled = false;
  };
  const submit = htl.html`<button ${{disabled: !resubmit && !required, onclick: onSubmit}}>${submitLabel}`;
  
//not actually going to show/use reset button but keeping logic in case we want
  const reset = htl.html`<button ${{disabled: true, onclick: onReset}}>${resetLabel}`; 
//  const footer = htl.html`<div><hr style="padding:0;margin:10px 0"><div style="display:flex;gap:1ch;justify-content:${justify}">${submit} ${reset}`;

// which buttons to show and space around them, center submit button
  const footer = htl.html`<div><hr style="padding:0;margin:10px 0"><div style="display:flex;gap:1ch;justify-content:${justify}">${submit}`;

// format the input toolbar, remove the extra inside <div>s commented to not stack them, but flex wrapping not working
const template = inputs => htl.html`
  <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; width: 100%;">
  <div>
    ${(Array.isArray(inputs) ? inputs : Object.values(inputs)).map(
      input => htl.html`
        <div style="flex: 1 1 200px; flex-wrap: wrap; min-width: 0;">
          <span style="display: block; width: 100%;">${input}</span>
        </div>
      `
    )}
  </div>
  </div>
  ${footer}
`;
  
  const input = fn({submit, reset, footer, template, onSubmit, onReset});
  let invalid = !!input.querySelector(":invalid");
  submit.disabled = !resubmit || invalid;

  input.addEventListener("input", onInnerInputCapture, {capture: true});
  input.addEventListener("input", onInnerInput);
  let value = required ? undefined : input.value;
  const wrapper = htl.html`<div style="width:${width}">${input}`;
  //const wrapper = htl.html`<div>${input}`;
  wrapper.addEventListener("submit", onSubmit);
  return Object.defineProperty(wrapper, "value", {
    get: () => value,
    set: (v) => { input.value = v },
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
function stackedBarChart(longData, width, height, chartTitle) {

console.log("stackedBarChart called with longData:", longData);
console.log("stackedBarChart called with width", width);
console.log("stackedBarChart called with  height", height);
console.log("stackedBarChart called with chartTitle:", chartTitle);

  return Plot.plot({
    className: "ELAgrowth-plot",
        
    width,
    height,
    marginLeft: 80,
    marginBottom: 50,
    title: chartTitle,
    
    x: { label: null, domain: [...new Set(longData.map(d => d.label))]},
    y: { label: "# Students", grid: true, labelArrow: false,
  labelAnchor: "center", dx: 100},
    color: {
      domain: ["Proficient", "Not Proficient", "Not Tested"],
      range: ["#2F7F73", "#D95C5C", "#B7BDC4"],
      legend: true
    },
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleY([0]),
      Plot.barY(longData, Plot.stackY({
        x: "label",
        y: "count",
        fill: "category",
        tip: true,
        title: d => `${d.category}: ${d.count} ${d.pct != null ? ` (${d.pct.toFixed(1)}%)\n(${d.pct2.toFixed(1)}% of Tested only)` : ""}`
      }))
    ]
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Turn the "Grade" selection into a YEAR -> ASSESSMENT_NAME sequence.
// If "All Grades (3-8)" was picked, every year uses ELA3_8.
// If a single grade was picked, the newest year (2025) uses that grade,
//   and each earlier year steps back one grade (2024 = grade-1, 2023 = grade-2,
//   2022 = grade-4) so we're following the SAME cohort of students back in time.
// Grade 3 is the youngest tested grade, so any offset that would push the
//   cohort below Grade 3 (e.g. Grade 2, Grade 1) is dropped entirely -
//   that data will never exist.
gradeSequence = {
  // inputSels is undefined until the form is first Submitted - bail out with
  // an empty sequence rather than throwing
  if (!inputSels) return [];
  const g = inputSels.grade;
  return [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]
    .filter(offset => g === "ELA3_8" || (g - offset) >= 3)
    .map(offset => ({
      year: baseYear - offset,
      assessment: g === "ELA3_8" ? "ELA3_8" : `ELA${g - offset}`
    }));
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
shared_dataFiltered = {
  if (!inputSels) return [];
//  const county = inputSels.county.trim().toUpperCase();
  const district = inputSels.district.trim().toUpperCase();

// filter all data and return District(ENTITY_NAME) Selected and Assessment(ie, ELA3 or 4 based on the grade selected)
  return shared_data.filter(d =>
//    d.COUNTY_DESC.toUpperCase() === county &&
    d.ENTITY_NAME.toUpperCase() === district &&
    gradeSequence.some(g => Number(g.year) === Number(d.YEAR) && g.assessment === d.ASSESSMENT_NAME)
  );
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// label for the assessment, used on the x-axis
gradeLabel = assessment => assessment === "ELA3_8"
  ? "All Grades 3-8"
  : `Grade ${assessment.replace("ELA", "")}`
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
function subgroupRows(subgroupName) {
  // console.log("subgroupRows called with subgroupName:", subgroupName);
  // console.log("gradeSequence:", gradeSequence);
  // console.log("shared_dataFiltered length:", shared_dataFiltered.length);

  const byYear = [...gradeSequence]
    .sort((a, b) => a.year - b.year)
    .map(({ year, assessment }) => {
      const row = shared_dataFiltered.find(d =>
        Number(d.YEAR) === Number(year) &&
        d.ASSESSMENT_NAME === assessment &&
        d.SUBGROUP_NAME === subgroupName
      );

// Console Logs to troubleshoot
      <!-- if (!row) { -->
      <!--   console.log( -->
      <!--     `No matching row for year=${year}, assessment=${assessment}, subgroup=${subgroupName}` -->
      <!--   ); -->
      <!-- } else { -->
      <!--   console.log( -->
      <!--     `Match found for year=${year}, assessment=${assessment}, subgroup=${subgroupName}:`, -->
      <!--     row -->
      <!--   ); -->
      <!-- } -->

      return {
        YEAR: year,
        label: `${year}\n${gradeLabel(assessment)}`,
        Prof_Count: row ? +row.Prof_Count : 0,
        NotProf_Count: row ? +row.NotProf_Count : 0,
        NOT_TESTED: row ? +row.NOT_TESTED : 0,
        Prof_Pct: row ? +row.Prof_Pct : null,
        NotProf_Pct: row ? +row.NotProf_Pct : null,
        PER_PROF: row ? +row.PER_PROF : null
      };
    });

  // console.log("subgroupRows - byYear:", byYear);

  const result = byYear.flatMap(d => [
    { label: d.label, YEAR: d.YEAR, category: "Proficient", count: d.Prof_Count, pct: d.Prof_Pct, pct2: d.PER_PROF },
    { label: d.label, YEAR: d.YEAR, category: "Not Proficient", count: d.NotProf_Count, pct: null },
    { label: d.label, YEAR: d.YEAR, category: "Not Tested", count: d.NOT_TESTED, pct: null }
  ]);

  // console.log("subgroupRows flatMap - result:", result);

  return result;
}
```
